answer: Agents bond economic stake that decays on conflicting or low-quality work. Each new identity starts at zero, forcing sybils to pay the full cost of reputation accumulation. This creates an onyx barrier — the cost to maintain a fleet of fake agents spirals upward as each must individually build credibility. Honest agents enjoy a compounding ripple effect: good work builds trust faster than decay erodes it, making authenticity profitable and sybil attacks economically irrational.
